text:
Clara: Quick sync — I'm drafting the benchmark launch posts + webinar copy. Need to lock the latency/cost chart language and the inbound routing matrix today. Ask: 3 short social captions (fast path, cost savings, reliability), 1 webinar hook, and a simple routing tag per caption. Can we each drop 1 line of microcopy + preferred chart type (heatmap / sparkline / waterfall) + routing tag? Example mapping I started below.

Ethan: Sparkline — 'Same output, less compute: 2x speed for common prompts.' routing: #sales-enterprise. Chart: sparkline. :zap:

Jordan: Heatmap — 'Tail latency matters: 95th pctl under 200ms for interactive apps.' routing: #product-marketing. Chart: heatmap. (Use color banding not gradients)

Priya: Waterfall for cost breakdown — 'Tokens to dollars: see where savings come from.' routing: #demand-gen (send nurture). Chart: waterfall. CTA: register for webinar. :bar_chart:

Nora: Quick note — don't oversell perf without calling out eval set. Microcopy: 'Real workloads, verified gains' + small footnote link. routing: #solutions (SE follow-up). Chart: sparkline + small eval callout.

Clara: Nice. Can someone mock the inbound routing CSV? I'll drop into the automation.

Ethan: Here's a tiny CSV I can use:```chart_type,caption,routing_tag
sparkline,"Same output, less compute: 2x speed for common prompts.",sales-enterprise
heatmap,"Tail latency matters: 95th pctl under 200ms for interactive apps.",product-marketing
waterfall,"Tokens to dollars: see where savings come from.",demand-gen
sparkline,"Real workloads, verified gains",solutions```

Priya: For the webinar hook: 'How we sliced token costs and kept latency predictable — demo + live Q&A.' One-sentence blurb for the landing page: 'Join us to see the benchmarks and the exact playbook we used to cut inference costs.'

Jordan: Suggest A/B test copy on the registration page: A = 'Cut inference costs by 40%'; B = 'Match prod latency at lower cost' — route A leads to SDR, B to PM nurture.

Nora: Routing rule snippet for automation (pseudo-yaml):```- if routing_tag == 'sales-enterprise': assign: sd-team
- if routing_tag == 'product-marketing': assign: pm-team
- if routing_tag == 'demand-gen': assign: marketing-nurture
- if routing_tag == 'solutions': assign: se-followup```

Clara: Awesome. One more ask — can we pick final chart visuals by EOD? Ethan + Jordan please grab sample renders (png) and post here. I'll compile copy + routing CSV and push to the launch doc.

BenchmarkBot: benchmark-results-uploaded: 1758881400 — latest perf CSV available at https://redwood.ai/bench/1758 :robot_face:

Ethan: Will do renders in ~90 mins.

Priya: I'll draft the webinar landing copy and send to Clara for review.

Nora: I'll prepare the eval footnote and the A/B variants.

Clara: Thanks team — syncing later at 3pm if anyone wants to join to finalize visuals. :calendar:
